title: nostalgic velvety spicy turkish pork shoulder steaks dumplings
description: a rich and savory turkish-inspired dish featuring tender pork shoulder steaks and fluffy dumplings
instructions: season the pork shoulder steaks with salt, black pepper, and cayenne pepper (if using).
heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
add the onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
add the paprika and cumin to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
add the pork shoulder steaks to the skillet and cook until browned on both sides.
remove the pork shoulder steaks from the skillet and set aside.
in a large bowl, combine the flour and a pinch of salt.
gradually add the beef broth to the bowl, stirring with a fork until the dough comes together.
turn the dough out onto a floured surface and knead for 5 minutes.
divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
flatten each ball of dough into a disk shape and wrap each disk around a pork shoulder steak.
place the wrapped pork shoulder steaks in a large Dutch oven or pot with a lid and add enough water to cover the steaks.
bring the water to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
bake the pork shoulder steaks for 30 minutes, then remove the pot from the oven and simmer on the stovetop for 10 minutes.
serve the pork shoulder steaks and dumplings hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
serve with a side of yogurt sauce (see below for recipe).
yogurt sauce: mix together 1 cup of plain yogurt, 1 tablespoon of lemon juice, and 1 tablespoon of chopped fresh dill. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.
